items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: and that trumpet section with Doc Severinsen as the lead trumpet player, Clark Terry and Snooky Young and Jimmy Maxwell. Going to that studio at NBC every day.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Those were great things.

And I always loved the dates with Tony Bennett. Johnny Mandel came in, Roy Burns, Torrie Zito, great conductors, great bands. Sol Gubin or Grady Tate on drums, George Duvivier or Richard Davis or Ron Carter on bass. And the wonderful saxophone sections which were Al Cohn and Zoot Sims and all those great players, and the string sections. The big recording studios. And then my years on the Tonight Show in New York for a couple of years I had to learn — and that trumpet section with Doc Severinsen as the lead…
You guys kind of worked out who was going to do what nights is that right?
